slice: RPP-5lc selected AC1027 five-element MLINE retarget tail append
scope: Qualifies one source-bound AC1027 retarget from a five-element style to another source-bound style after appending one sixth tail element. Verifies exact output fields, ownership, fresh readback, source-edit refusal, late-mutation rollback and same-adapter retries. This remains a selected adapter profile, not native semantic qualification.

references.use: Groups 71 and 49 encode element count and offsets, with repeated 49/62/6 tuples; group 70 contains flags. These field definitions do not prescribe consumer-geometry regeneration.

Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object; group 2 is its redundant name; group 73 records element count; groups 74/41 and 75/42 describe per-element segment and fill parameters; groups 13/23/33 carry vertex miter vectors.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 source. The original and target style geometries each have flags 2, angles 90/90, and offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.75]. The original tuple colors/LTYPEs are [1,3,4,5,6] and [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer]; the target's source tuples use colors [5,7,4,5,6] with the same LTYPE order. Two source-bound MLINE consumers have three vertices and are owned by model space and a named block. The target edit appends offset -3.75, ACI 4, ByLayer. Consumers are retargeted by group-340 identity and retain their redundant group-2 names.
contract.projection: Require the exact 5-to-6 target tail append; preserve all five source offsets as an ordered prefix, flags 2, and angles 90/90. Recompute each consumer's first group-41 parameter against the target minimum offset (-3.75), retaining source positions, segment directions, miter vectors and zero second parameters. Bottom justification uses the resulting +3.75 shift. This is not a general MLINE regeneration algorithm.
contract.outputAndReadback: Across ASCII/binary source and output, verify source and target MLINESTYLE tuple fields and dictionary ownership/keys; both group-340 consumer references, unchanged group-2 names, group 73=6, exact groups 74/75/41 and miter groups 13/23/33; model-space/block ownership; and fresh import of both styles and consumers with the six-element target and projected parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: For ASCII and binary output, an altered existing target offset refuses atomically, preserving destination sentinel and caller snapshot; restoring the original value permits same-adapter retry. Late consumer mutation also refuses atomically and succeeds after caller-state restoration. Four source/output encoding profiles, two source-edit refusals, two late-mutation refusals and four retries are present in the sourceCount==5 loop cases.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. DXF inputs and outputs are generated at runtime in a temporary directory and removed after successful test runs. No drawing fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers only AC1027 source count 5 to target count 6 by one tail append, the stated tuples and geometry, and two open/uncut/unfilled three-vertex consumers. Other source counts, append batches, angle/flag/offset edits, schemas, carriers, versions, native semantics, complete-document closure and broad support claims remain unqualified.
